name: Abbraccio
description: The Abbraccio armchair embodies the warmth and comfort of a true embrace. Its overlapping, sinuous curves combine the warmth of wood with the softness of upholstery, evoking the sense of calm and closeness that only a genuine embrace can offer. The first numbered piece from Uultis, it was produced in a limited edition of 100 units, all of which have been sold, making it an exclusive collector’s piece.
availability_note: Collector’s piece. The official page states that all 100 units have been sold.

name: Abrigo
description:
The Abrigo bed features continuous, rounded forms that convey warmth and tranquility. Its curved headboard creates a sense of refuge, while its low profile brings the piece closer to the floor, reinforcing a feeling of intimacy and a serene presence in the room.

Inspired by Scandinavian organic design and Brazilian modernism, Abrigo makes comfort an essential part of its design. Within the Simbiose collection, it speaks a quiet visual language, conceived to welcome, protect, and turn rest into a moment of true retreat.

name: Açu
description: Inspired by the history and meaning of “Paun-açu,” the term used by the Tupi-Guarani people for the majestic Pão de Açúcar, the Açu armchair expresses this sense of grandeur as a tribute to Brazil’s rich cultural heritage. Its flowing contours and commanding design capture the majesty of the landscape and the strength of the culture that surrounds us.

name: Aiby
description: Solid wood joins natural cotton weaving and fine fabrics to create a distinctive bed full of character, while preserving the lightness and natural lines that define Uultis products. The Aiby bed brings design and elegance into your bedroom. Its solid wood frame is padded with medium- and high-density foam, wrapped in a layer of Ecosoft foam. The model features a solid wood headboard with a natural weave, giving the bed a bold, contemporary design.

name: Aiby
description: With Aiby, comfort extends to every part of your sofa. The loose back cushions are filled with polyester fiber, while the arms combine solid wood and a natural weave in a modern, bold design. The frame is also made of solid wood, padded with medium- and high-density foam and wrapped in a layer of Ecosoft foam. What does that mean? A welcoming place for you and everyone who can join you.

name: Air
description: Designed to fit into any setting, the Air armchair has a clean, light appearance. It represents an evolution of traditional reclining armchairs. With reclining and swivel functions, its slim, sophisticated design combines harmonious proportions with an electric system that adjusts the footrest and backrest independently. Touch controls let users find their preferred level of comfort.

name: Alada
description:
The Alada armchair stands out in the collection by pairing soft volumes with a rigid, precisely defined side that acts as a supportive, protective “wing.” The seat and backrest have generous, welcoming forms, while the angled side defines the piece’s identity.

Its design suggests lightness and movement, as though it were about to take flight, without compromising stability or comfort. Both functional and sculptural, Alada offers support and a distinctive presence in the room.

Inspired by the experimental design of the 1960s and 1970s, with references to aeronautical design, Alada brings this heritage into the Simbiose collection, balancing technique, form, and a welcoming feel in a contemporary design.

name: Ali
description: With its light, refined design, the Ali mirror takes center stage in any setting. Its name, meaning “wings” in Italian, refers to the design of the piece. Together, the mirrors form two beautiful wings, creating a sense of movement and freedom in the room.

name: Alva
description:
Alva begins with the oval, a symbol of origin and continuity throughout the history of art. Its wooden design forms a continuous volume, with clean lines and a serene presence that emphasizes the clarity of its unadorned shape. An irregularly shaped handle emerges from the surface, interrupting the regularity of the wood and bringing a natural, poetic contrast to the design. This detail adds character to the piece, bringing precision and spontaneity together.

Within the Simbiose collection, Alva represents the meeting of the rational and the natural: a balanced piece with a quiet presence and timeless character.

name: Amura
description: The movement of the wind lies at the heart of the Amura armchair. Its arms and backrest are formed from cords that emphasize its connection with nature while providing comfort.

name: Angra
description: The Angra bench captures the serene, elegant essence of the coastal region of Angra dos Reis. Combining natural elements with a modern, functional design, it pays tribute to the sophistication and beauty of the local landscapes.

name: Ara
description:
The Ara table was created around the idea of gathering. Its elliptical top offers a generous, continuous surface designed for get-togethers, meals, and moments of pause. Solid wood columns support it, distributing its weight evenly. Two stone discs interrupt the wooden surface of the top, creating visual markers that reinforce the relationship between time, material, and use.
Inspired by modernist sculpture and the rigor of Brutalism, Ara celebrates simple forms and exposed materials. Within the Simbiose collection, it represents the meeting of natural and mineral elements, bringing a quiet, strong, and timeless presence to the room.

name: Arau
description: Inspired by the tree that symbolizes southern Brazil, the Arau dining table has a unique design. Its impressive span does justice to the Araucaria, with a striking base and captivating elegance.

name: Arc
description: The Arc coffee table blends the natural character of wood with the contemporary appeal of mirror, creating a light, sophisticated piece. Made from MDF faced with natural wood veneer, it has a glass or mirrored top and lacquered MDF legs. The table is available in three sizes.

name: Aros
description: The Aros armchair was designed for exceptional comfort without sacrificing its refined, distinctive character. Its swivel base makes it ideal for living spaces, bringing practicality together with the elegance of its details and materials.

name: Aura
description: The Aura sofa features natural hexagonal caning. This woven material brings the lightness and sense of well-being associated with the coast. Its curves are among its defining features, giving the piece a beautiful softness that provides both visual and physical comfort.

name: Ays
description: Like a true embrace, the Ays armchair features organic lines that recall iconic pieces from the world of fashion: puffer clothing and footwear. Its rounded shape helps a room flow, making it ideal for compact spaces where comfort comes first.

name: Bauh
description: The Bauh sofa combines the classic appeal of the Bauhaus with contemporary elements, creating harmony between past and present. A piece of design history, shaped with modern elegance, it pays tribute to this iconic style while remaining relevant today.

name: Bella
description: True to its name, this armchair and stool inspire love at first sight. Their metal frame supports a fully upholstered shell, generously padded with the finest foam so that the comfort suggested by their appearance is fully felt when they are used.

name: Benne
description: The Benne sofa rests on slender, tapered legs that give it the impression of floating above the floor, creating a very clean appearance. Its seating system can be arranged in several configurations, offering a deeply comforting experience.

name: Bone
description: This chair has distinctive yet light lines, bringing strength and delicacy together. It features a solid wood frame, an anatomically curved plywood backrest, and medium-density foam in the seat. It is hard to choose which is better: its appearance or its comfort.

name: Bonito
description: The Bonito armchair embodies the serenity and natural beauty of Bonito, Mato Grosso do Sul, combining comfort with a sophisticated aesthetic to create a retreat of tranquility and style.

name: Bowed
description: Organic form and softness define the Bowed sofa. With curved lines throughout its design, the piece brings comfort and a contemporary character together through its iconic silhouette.

name: Buddy
description: The Buddy sofa offers a wide range of possibilities, from the elegance and softness of its forms to the comfort and practicality of its operation. Buddy uniquely combines the simple forms of a living room sofa with the exceptional comfort of an extendable sofa.

name: Cacau
description: Through its curves and details, the Cacau dining table embodies the strength and elegance of one of the earth’s most precious treasures: cocoa. Its base, which recalls the fruit’s seed, captures the essence of nature in its most refined form, evoking indulgence and sophistication as an invitation to collect memorable moments.

name: Camboriú
description: This sofa has a contemporary design that reflects the modern, cosmopolitan character of Balneário Camboriú. It features clean lines reminiscent of the city’s skyscrapers or decorative elements that evoke a contemporary style.

name: Capitólio
description: An armchair that complements a contemporary living room while evoking the natural beauty and rustic chic charm of Capitólio. It provides a place for relaxation and contemplation, inspired by the region’s breathtaking landscapes.

name: Cappio
description: A chair with a solid wood base, a natural finish, and a seat and backrest available in fabric or leather. Made for both style and relaxation.

name: Carambola
description:
The Carambola coffee table is inspired by the natural geometry of the fruit after which it is named. Its hexagonal shape and generous proportions create a striking presence in the room, bringing geometric design together with a reference to nature.

The handcrafted glass top, with its subtle concavity, offers a variety of uses: holding objects or flowers, or reflecting the light of the space. The metal base, formed from rods that open out like a fan, creates a play of light and shadow that changes with the viewing angle, bringing visual movement to the piece.

Within the collection, Carambola combines function and expression. It is a table that organizes, decorates, and invites contemplation, celebrating Brazilian design’s ability to unite aesthetics, memory, and everyday use.

name: Carioca
description: The Carioca chair combines soft lines and balanced proportions, with a wooden frame and upholstery that ensures comfort in use. A versatile piece with an elegant aesthetic and a timeless presence.

name: Catamarã
description:
The Catamarã stool is born of time, careful construction, and respect for material. Its design begins with two blocks of wood that form solid bases, between which the seat and backrest curve to support the body naturally and comfortably.

Inspired by modernism, Catamarã celebrates the honesty of materials and forms: exposed wood, clearly defined curves, and a structure that reveals how the piece is built. A more fundamental reference also emerges, recalling objects made to last, where form and function go hand in hand.

With a calm yet distinctive presence, Catamarã stands out without excess. A chair designed to accompany everyday life with comfort, balance, and a design that transcends time.

name: Catamarã
description:
The Catamarã chair is born of time, careful construction, and respect for material. Its design begins with two blocks of wood that form solid bases, between which the seat and backrest curve to support the body naturally and comfortably.

Inspired by modernism, Catamarã celebrates the honesty of materials and forms: exposed wood, clearly defined curves, and a structure that reveals how the piece is built. A more fundamental reference also emerges, recalling objects made to last, where form and function go hand in hand.

With a calm yet distinctive presence, Catamarã stands out without excess. A chair designed to accompany everyday life with comfort, balance, and a design that transcends time.

name: Catamarã
description: Catamarã is born of time: the kind that allows a material to reveal its true form. Made from blocks of wood that support precise curves, it brings strength and serenity into perfect balance. Inspired by modernism and traditional handcraft, it holds on to the essential: nothing is superfluous, and everything has a purpose. Like an anchored boat, it has a quiet presence, ready to set off yet always steady. A piece of furniture that welcomes without confining, accompanies without dominating, and finds its place with quiet purpose.

name: Catu
description: The Catu armchair brings elegance and lightness together in a timeless design. With soft lines and balanced proportions, it embodies sophistication and comfort. Its ergonomic shape provides ideal support for the body, while delicate curves and precise finishes highlight its refined form. Ideal for interiors that value tradition and style, the Catu armchair expresses a harmony between charm and contemporary comfort.

name: Cigno
description: Inspiration, room to breathe, and a welcoming feel: the Cigno sofa is full of comfort. Its seat and backrest feature elastic webbing and medium-density foam covered with a layer of Ecosoft foam. The loose back cushions are filled with polyester fiber and foam flakes. Its frame is made of plantation-grown eucalyptus wood and MDF panels, providing exceptional strength and preventing creaking. Solid wood arms and legs add an even more contemporary appearance.

name: Cipó
description: Inspired by the winding vegetation of the Amazon, its meticulous design captures the organic character and flexibility of nature. Beyond physical comfort, it invites you to reconnect with Brazil’s green essence, transforming an outdoor space into an oasis of natural beauty and serenity.

name: Cipó
description: Inspired by the winding vegetation of the Amazon, its meticulous design captures the organic character and flexibility of nature. Beyond physical comfort, it invites you to reconnect with Brazil’s green essence, transforming an outdoor space into an oasis of natural beauty and serenity.

name: Clip
description: A commanding presence and organic elegance shape the Clip sofa, which places great value on comfort and a welcoming feel. Its more substantial frame contrasts with the softness of its sculpted solid wood legs, which connect to and support the piece.

name: Cloud
description: The Cloud desk brings creativity and functionality together in a distinctive piece that combines the beauty of wood with the strength of iron, creating a balance between the natural and the industrial. Its solid wood top evokes authenticity and a connection with nature, while the wood’s unique texture and subtle variations in color give the piece personality and character.

name: Cogo
description: Cogo symbolizes the multiculturalism and diversity of Brazilian cities. Its name reflects the connection between tradition and modernity within Brazil’s social and cultural context.

name: Connect
description: The CONNECT sofa allows arrangements ranging from formal to relaxed. It can become an inviting sofa for face-to-face conversations, a chaise longue for reading and relaxation, or even a large, freestanding bed. The CONNECT sofa’s design has a quiet elegance, thanks to the combination of its gentle flow, forms, and precise lines.

name: Connect
description: The Connect veranda sofa allows arrangements ranging from formal to relaxed. It can become an inviting sofa for face-to-face conversations, a chaise longue for reading and relaxation, or even a large, freestanding bed. The Connect sofa’s design has a quiet elegance, thanks to the combination of its gentle flow, forms, and precise lines.

name: Cubi
description:
As its name suggests, Cubi features geometric forms and pure lines, creating a harmonious, elegant combination.

The Cubi dining chair brings a design of pure, geometric lines into harmony with the solidity of solid wood, resulting in an imposing and comfortable piece.

name: Cubus
description: The clean, geometric form of a cube is the foundation for the Cubus armchair. With intersecting angles and faces of equal dimensions, both the cube and Cubus express a balanced approach to minimalist architecture. Compact yet commanding, the armchair is versatile.

name: Divinus
description: Divinus represents the height of luxury and sophistication in a mattress. Technology and comfort combine with the originality of a mattress made from materials that offer unmatched comfort. The richness of its elements finds expression in design, creating distinctive pieces for your night’s sleep. A highlight is the remarkable Skin+ technology applied to the Jacquard fabric. This treatment uses probiotics applied to the fabric, which produce carotenoids capable of repairing damage to our skin. Friction between the body and the mattress releases microcapsules and activates the probiotics, allowing them to reproduce and multiply after each use. This technology works so effectively that Skin+ remains active even when the mattress is covered with sheets. Your mattress does the work for you, night after night.

name: Dolomitas
description: Inspiration is experience transformed into ideas. One of design’s treasures is its ability to give shape and life to products with something special at their core. This is how the Dolomitas dining table came into being: a piece of iconic design inspired by the beautiful Dolomites, a rocky mountain range in northern Italy recognized by UNESCO as a World Heritage Site for its natural beauty and geological significance.

name: Domo
description: The spherical lines of the Domo chaise recall the dome of the Casa de Cultura Mário Quintana, inviting you to escape life’s demands and lose yourself in the beauty of art and the horizon stretching out before you.

name: Domo
description: The spherical lines of the Domo chaise recall the dome of the Casa de Cultura Mário Quintana, inviting you to escape life’s demands and lose yourself in the beauty of art and the horizon stretching out before you.

name: Duomo
description: Refinement and elegance for any setting. Soft forms shaped in solid wood give the Duomo mirror an identity of its own.

name: Eixo
description: The Eixo console table brings form and function together: a standout piece that goes beyond its basic purpose to become an expression of elegance and practicality in the room. It carries the authenticity and natural character of wood, conveying stability through the composition of its form and the softness of its base.

name: Elbow
description: Charm and sophistication define the Elbow bed. Its upholstered frame emphasizes the solid wood details, which stand out and create a harmonious appearance, allowing it to become the focal point of any bedroom.

name: Elo
description: The Elo dining chair draws on 1950s Scandinavian design in its pursuit of fluidity and continuity, while embracing the Brazilian tradition of treating wood as a living material, revealing visible grain and welcoming curves. In this context, the name Elo is particularly apt: it expresses the absence of hierarchy between the versions and their role as complementary expressions of a single idea, inviting conversations that linger.

name: Elos
description:
The Elos armchair combines continuous curves with a precise structure in a design that conveys movement and lightness. Its form resembles a line drawn through space, creating a fluid, distinctive presence in the room.

The large arc surrounding the piece recalls twentieth-century modern sculpture, in which free, open forms take center stage, as in the work of artists who explored the balance between void and material. This reference gives Elos a sculptural character, distinguished not only by its comfort but also by its aesthetic value.

Its soft upholstery contrasts with the surrounding structure, balancing a welcoming feel with firmness. In the Uultis 2026 collection, Elos brings design, art, and comfort together in a piece for those seeking more than a seat: presence, identity, and expression within a space.

name: Enlace
description:
Enlace is designed to belong naturally within its surroundings. Its continuous curves create a welcoming form without rigid edges, inviting the body to settle comfortably.

At the ends, a rolled metal element appears subtly, bringing strength and balance to the design. References to Brazilian modernism and Italian design unite structure, material, and comfort in a clear, sculptural language.

Within the Simbiose collection, Enlace expresses the idea of connection: a piece that brings the person sitting in it into harmony with the space, creating interiors that feel more welcoming, serene, and full of presence.

name: Éter
description:
The Éter bar cabinet balances solidity and lightness in a design of continuous lines and gentle curves. Its body is raised on a base, creating a sense of suspension, while vertical handles introduce rhythm and emphasize the piece’s design.

Quiet and elegant, Éter transforms its surroundings with an understated presence. Inspired by modernism and minimalism, it celebrates pure volumes and continuous surfaces, removing excess to highlight the essence of the design.

Within the Simbiose collection, Éter unites function and poetry in a piece conceived for organizing, entertaining, and creating sophisticated moments of pause.

name: Falésias
description: The Falésias bench is inspired by the commanding beauty of cliffs rising from the ocean’s blue waters. With a solid structure and elegant lines, it symbolizes the balance between the built environment and the natural serenity around it.

name: Fane
description: The Fane armchair offers enduring style, right down to the finishes that create its distinctive design and exceptional comfort. Its solid wood frame, steel staples, and PVA glue provide strength and prevent creaking. That is Fane: whatever the setting, it always stands out.

name: Fine
description: With its contemporary design, the Fine sofa features solid wood arms produced using advanced technology. A touch of elegance and refinement, ideal for creating sophisticated interiors.

name: Fiorde
description:
The Fiorde sofa takes its inspiration from natural landscapes, with volumes that recall forms softened by time. Its organic curves create a piece with a distinctive presence, conveying fluidity and a welcoming feel.

The upholstery combines softness and structure in a balance that recalls the meeting of land and water in the fjords. There are also references to modern sculpture with biomorphic forms, where lines flow continuously without pronounced angles.

Within the Simbiose collection, Fiorde represents the relationship between body and landscape. A sofa that invites rest and transforms its surroundings into a more natural, welcoming, and expressive space.

name: Flap
description: Comfort and bold design define the Flap armchair. Its backrest resembles wings that embrace the seat, giving the piece a commanding presence and a high level of comfort. The solid wood base provides the support it needs while adding further charm to this beautiful armchair.

name: Floripa
description: Floripa is a piece of furniture that expresses the vibrant, natural essence of the island of Florianópolis, in Santa Catarina. Inspired by its idyllic beaches, dunes, and relaxed atmosphere, it combines contemporary elegance with natural elements, offering comfort and style in any setting.

name: Fortuno
description: Fortuno represents the height of luxury and sophistication in a mattress. Technology and comfort combine with the originality of a mattress made from materials that offer unmatched comfort. The richness of its elements finds expression in design, creating distinctive pieces for your night’s sleep. A highlight is the remarkable Skin+ technology applied to the Jacquard fabric. This treatment uses probiotics applied to the fabric, which produce carotenoids capable of repairing damage to our skin. Friction between the body and the mattress releases microcapsules and activates the probiotics, allowing them to reproduce and multiply after each use. This technology works so effectively that Skin+ remains active even when the mattress is covered with sheets. Your mattress does the work for you, night after night.

name: Fractus
description: The Fractus table embodies the essence of expansion and endless possibilities. With meticulously designed angles, it evokes the sensation of contemplating a growing fractal. The fusion of beauty and precision makes discovering the piece a unique experience, inviting touch and visual appreciation.

name: Frame
description: With simple, organic lines, it brings beauty to any setting, on its own or arranged with other pieces.

name: Frame
description: A mirror with simple, organic lines that brings beauty to any setting, on its own or arranged with other pieces.

name: Frame
description: Simple, gentle lines make Frame mirrors at home in any setting. Their many possible arrangements can adapt to all kinds of interiors, ensuring there is a composition to suit your space.

name: Garda
description: The Garda armchair brings structural clarity and organic expression together. Its lines flow without interruption, while its curved, open backrest adds sculptural character and lightness. The generous seat introduces warmth and tactile comfort, balancing precision with softness. Inspired by the tranquility of Lago di Garda, the piece expresses a serene elegance in which every detail reflects a precise dialogue between form, material, and sensitivity.

name: Garda
description: The Garda chair brings structural clarity and organic expression together. Its lines flow without interruption, while its curved, open backrest adds sculptural character and lightness. The seat introduces warmth and tactile comfort, balancing precision with softness. Inspired by the tranquility of Lago di Garda, the piece expresses a serene elegance in which every detail reflects a precise dialogue between form, material, and sensitivity.

name: Garda
description: The Garda chair brings structural clarity and organic expression together. Its lines flow without interruption, while its curved, open backrest adds sculptural character and lightness. The seat introduces warmth and tactile comfort, balancing precision with softness. Inspired by the tranquility of Lago di Garda, the piece expresses a serene elegance in which every detail reflects a precise dialogue between form, material, and sensitivity.

name: Gavea
description: The Gávea sofa brings the grandeur of nature together with the sophistication of contemporary design. Inspired by the majestic Pedra da Gávea, one of Rio de Janeiro’s most iconic landmarks, this sofa brings the scale and charm of rock formations into the home.

name: Gavea
description: The Gávea sofa brings the grandeur of nature together with the sophistication of contemporary design. Inspired by the majestic Pedra da Gávea, one of Rio de Janeiro’s most iconic landmarks, this sofa brings the scale and charm of rock formations into the home.

name: Gen
description: Inspired by the brilliance of creative thinking, the Gen sofa is a modern expression of innovation and comfort. Its bold lines and distinctive forms reflect the forward-looking vision that runs through contemporary design. Gen is more than a piece of furniture: it is a confident statement of style and functionality.

name: Gig
description: The Gig swing expresses simplicity through two pure, elegant lines. The nautical rope woven around its frame and supporting the swing recalls the breeze of a summer day by the sea.

name: Gig
description: Pure, elegant forms bring comfort and practicality together in a single piece. The Gig sofa was designed especially for veranda spaces. Its aluminum frame and woven nautical rope give this distinctive piece its design character and personality.

name: Grain
description: Minimalist and contemporary, the Grain stool was inspired by Brazil's finest grains. Its light, organic form allows the wood to take center stage without overlooking the upholstery and backrest.

name: Grain
description: Minimalist and contemporary, the Grain chair was inspired by Brazil's finest grains. Its light, organic form allows the wood to take center stage without overlooking the upholstery and backrest.

name: Granum
description: Inspired by the idea of a grain that nourishes and energizes, the Granum armchair is like breakfast for the senses: a harmonious combination of comfort and style. With lines that recall the richness and individuality of each coffee bean, it offers an irresistible invitation to relax and enjoy moments of pure pleasure. Its elegance rises above the everyday, just as a good coffee can transform a morning.

name: Graviola
description:
The Graviola table complements the collection's family of tables and expresses Acioli's sculptural view of everyday life. Its design balances weight and lightness: a base made of metal rods supports a handcrafted glass top that seems to float, creating a play of transparency and reflections.

The top's irregular, almost organic shape reinforces the piece's handcrafted character and creates a visual dialogue with the Carambola table, which shares the same design language.

Graviola can stand alone as a focal point or join other pieces in a composition that brings rhythm, light, and texture into focus. Between the natural and the architectural, it reaffirms Uultis's aim of turning everyday use into a visual experience.

name: Gugge
description: Straight, minimalist lines define Gugge, a wooden console table with curved contours. Its design was inspired by the iconic, renowned Guggenheim Museum in New York, whose distinctive architecture celebrates rounded forms across its façade.

name: High
description: With a refined frame that showcases the finest woodworking, this sofa features an innovative construction process that sets it apart from its peers. It is an example of manufacturing that brings together advanced technology to ensure maximum comfort.

name: Hórus
description: A sofa with a solid wood frame and legs, a natural finish, and a foam-padded backrest and seat. Comfort comes first, wherever you are.

name: Igriega
description:
The Igriega armchair balances solidity and softness in a design with a striking presence. Its wooden supports are essential and architectural, while the generous, low upholstery gently embraces the body.

The name evokes the classical tradition, but the design avoids literal references in favor of a direct, restrained form. The influence of primitive sculpture and brutalism can be seen in the honest, unadorned way the materials are presented.

Within the Simbiose collection, Igriega acts as a visual anchor, bringing a sense of stability, permanence, and balance to the space.

name: Imperium
description: Imperium represents the height of luxury and sophistication in a mattress. Technology and comfort come together with the originality of a mattress made from exceptional materials, offering unparalleled comfort. The richness of its elements finds support in design, creating distinctive pieces for your night's sleep. A highlight is the remarkable Skin+ technology applied to the Jacquard fabric. This treatment is based on probiotics applied to the fabric, which produce carotenoids capable of repairing damage to our skin. Friction between the body and the mattress releases the microcapsules and activates the probiotics, allowing them to reproduce and multiply after each use. The technology works so effectively that Skin+ remains active even when the mattress is covered with sheets. Your mattress will do the work for you, night after night.

name: Inhotim
description: Inspired by the emblematic Inhotim Museum, their legs, sculpted from blocks of solid wood, evoke impressive structural solidity while capturing the organic forms found in Inhotim's buildings and installations.

name: Ipê
description: The armchair's design evokes the elegance and solidity of ipê trees, with curved, organic lines that recall the contours of Brazil's tropical forests.

name: Íris
description: Inspired by the striking volumes of the Eye Museum in Curitiba, it highlights the creative boldness and structural elegance of the renowned Brazilian architect. Like the iris of the human eye, this chair is a dynamic work, offering exceptional support and comfort. Its flowing design harmoniously combines form and function, inviting a distinctive experience.

name: Itamaraty
description: Itamaraty combines the elegance of the arches of Itamaraty Palace with functional contemporary design. Its commanding base reflects the curves and openings of the architecture's sweeping arches, providing structural support and an aesthetic focal point that defines its distinctive identity.

name: Itamaraty
description: Itamaraty combines the elegance of the arches of Itamaraty Palace with functional contemporary design. Its commanding base reflects the curves and openings of the architecture's sweeping arches, providing structural support and an aesthetic focal point that defines its distinctive identity.

name: Jalapão
description: The Jalapão armchair evokes the cerrado through organic forms and details drawn from local culture, offering comfort and style inspired by the region's biodiversity and beauty.

name: Jurerê
description:
The Jurerê armchair has a strong design, with generous, clearly defined volumes inspired by Brazilian modern architecture. Its form recalls solid, stable structures built to last, while gentle curves embrace the body in comfort.

The upholstery appears as a single, soft volume, while the wooden frame remains visible and plays an important role in the piece's appearance. Nothing is concealed: the way the armchair is supported is part of the design itself, creating a sense of security and presence in the room.

Curved lines and a firm base create an armchair that conveys stability, comfort, and calm. It is a piece designed to endure, to be lived with every day, and to furnish spaces that value time, quality, and well-being.

Jurerê expresses a discreet, essential luxury, felt in its touch, proportions, and honest materials.

name: Juruá
description: Inspired by the lushness and biodiversity of the Amazon rainforest around the Juruá River, the armchair's design incorporates organic forms and gentle curves that recall the river's winding course and the natural shapes found in the forest.

name: Kora
description: The interwoven metal frame of the Kora coffee table evokes the security and strength of an embrace. Wooden sections form the top above the frame, finished with natural cane and cotton weaving. The simplicity of the form and the refinement of the materials give the piece a sense of distinction.

name: Kora
description: The interwoven metal frame of the Kora console table evokes the security and strength of an embrace. Wooden sections form the top above the frame, finished with natural cotton weaving. The simplicity of the form and the refinement of the materials give the piece a sense of distinction.

name: Laguna
description: Exploring its principal visual elements, the Laguna armchair evokes nature and modern architecture. It combines metal, wood, fabric, and woven cane, expressing its details through endless possibilities.

name: Lapa
description: Combining modernity and tradition, this piece was inspired by the iconic Lapa Arches in Rio de Janeiro. It celebrates Brazilian design, bringing historical elements together with contemporary, innovative materials. Its fluid, harmonious aesthetic evokes colonial architecture and symbolizes the connection between past and present.

name: Li
description: Li is a set of side tables with an exceptionally clean, minimalist style. A top finished in natural wood veneer and a stainless steel base create a strong sense of harmony between these two distinct materials.

name: Lig
description: The LIG dining chair uses minimalist forms in its frame to draw attention to the handwoven backrest, adding beauty and a distinctive personal character. Its features allow it to work in a variety of settings alongside pieces in different materials and styles.

name: Like
description: A piece built around parallels: elegance and function, wood and metal. Its distinctive shape and unconventional appearance are sure to attract attention.

name: Lírio
description: A reinterpretation of the flower that gives it its name, the Lírio armchair brings organic forms together with the comfort of a double embrace that only nature can offer.

name: Lírio
description: A reinterpretation of the flower that gives it its name, the Lírio armchair brings organic forms together with the comfort of a double embrace that only nature can offer.

name: Lírio
description: Conceived and developed from the same principles as the Lírio armchair, the Lírio stool is a complementary piece that shares its defining lines. It brings organic forms and upholstery together, creating warmth and sensations that only nature can offer.

name: Litoral
description: The Litoral side table offers elegance as well as functionality. Inspired by nature and modern architecture, its forms and materials combine metal, wood, and woven cane to explore distinctive details and limitless creative possibilities.

name: Loop
description: Charm, lightness, and exceptional comfort define the Loop armchair. Its pure design begins with an aluminum frame that forms a shell around the upholstery, ensuring ergonomics and durability. Nautical rope wraps around the frame in handmade loops, adding an exclusive touch and giving this beautiful piece its name.

name: Lou
description: A sofa made from solid wood. In addition to foam padding, the seat and backrest are wrapped in an Ecosoft foam layer. The legs are also solid wood, and you choose the color: almond, imbuia, black, or white. Relaxing comes naturally.

name: Luna
description: The Luna armchair is an elegant, contemporary piece of furniture that combines the comfort of a chaise longue with a design inspired by the beauty of the moon. Designed to evoke serenity and elegance, this chaise incorporates gentle lines and aesthetic details that recall the mysterious, fascinating moon.

name: Lux
description: Comfort, practicality, and contemporary design: everything a reclining modular sofa needs. For even more comfort, there is an optional central armrest with a lift-up side table, LED lighting, and aluminum cup holders.

name: Lygia
description: With a visual identity closely connected to the relaxing atmosphere of tropical destinations, the Lygia lounger was conceived to provide comfort and versatility outdoors. Its combination of materials and emphasis on wood create a perfect synergy between nature and the high standards of contemporary spaces.

name: Lygia
description: With details drawn from luxury beach houses, resorts, and spas, the Lygia table does more than serve a practical purpose. It contributes to the appearance and comfort of an outdoor space, enriching the experience of gathering as well as its design. Its top, adorned with carefully arranged wooden slats, evokes a sense of naturalness and connection with the outdoors.

name: Magnólia
description:
The Magnólia dining table is inspired by the lightness and delicacy of the flower that gives it its name. Its design balances strength and softness in a piece intended for both indoor and outdoor use.

The high-strength aluminum frame ensures durability with visual lightness. A wooden detail adds warmth and personality, while the subtly textured handcrafted glass top creates reflections that enhance the relationship between light, material, and setting.

Within the Uultis collection, Magnólia stands out for its elegant, versatile presence. A table that adapts to different residential and commercial spaces, transforming time together into an occasion for connection, comfort, and contemplation.

name: Manaus
description: The Manaus chair is inspired by the harmony between the world's largest tropical rainforest and its capital, highlighting the balance between urban life and nature. Combining wood and upholstery for a soft, welcoming touch, its design of pure, straight forms symbolizes the integration of planned urban growth with the natural environment.

name: Manaus
description: The Manaus chair is inspired by the harmony between the world's largest tropical rainforest and its capital, highlighting the balance between urban life and nature. Combining wood and upholstery for a soft, welcoming touch, its design of pure, straight forms symbolizes the integration of planned urban growth with the natural environment.

name: Maragogi
description: Surrounded by the natural beauty of Alagoas, Maragogi evokes the richness of its Indigenous roots. Its name carries meanings associated with purity and nature: “crystal-clear waters.” Known as the Brazilian Caribbean, it is a haven of tranquility. Inspired by this serene atmosphere, we present a sofa that harmonizes freshness, comfort, and elegance.

name: Mare
description: Inspired by the gentle curves of waves meeting the shore, the Mare armchair celebrates the balance between form and function. It pays tribute to nature's calming power and the ability to create spaces that recall the serenity of the seaside, surrounding you with an ocean of comfort and elegance.

name: Maru
description: The Maru stool finds its form in the origins of Brazilian culture, recalling the traditional woven-straw sieves used by Indigenous communities to prepare food. It draws a parallel between culture and lived experience, reflecting the social setting in which meals take place. In the Maru stool, the sieve moves beyond decoration to become part of everyday life for those who share enriching cultural experiences.

name: Mat
description: Mat is a vintage-style chair with the form of an armchair, made using woodworking technology. Its frame showcases meticulous joinery that gives it a gentle appearance.

name: Mat
description: Mat is a vintage-style chair with the form of an armchair, made using woodworking technology. Its frame showcases meticulous joinery that gives it a gentle appearance.

name: Mat
description: The familiar Mat chair, a Uultis classic, is now available in the Sense collection. The same care in its woodworking is now combined with woven nautical rope, helping furnish outdoor settings with elegance and timeless appeal.

name: Meandro
description:
Before it is a sofa, Meandro is movement. Its curved lines are inspired by the course of rivers, translating the idea of continuous flow into interior design. It is furniture conceived to follow the body, the space, and the rhythm of those who live there.

Its modular structure allows for different compositions. Each module connects freely, creating new possibilities for use and layout. This flexibility reflects the concept of the Simbiose collection, which values the relationship between forms, materials, and ways of living.

Fabric and wood come together in organic, clearly defined volumes, combining comfort and precision. Meandro is not limited to a single configuration: it adapts, transforms, and evolves with the space.

In the Uultis vision, Meandro expresses the balance between movement and permanence, a sofa designed to accompany contemporary life with elegance, comfort, and identity.

name: Meandro
description:
The Meandro Sofa Table translates the idea of movement into an occasional piece that naturally organizes and follows the space. Its elongated, curved design is inspired by the course of rivers, creating a continuous surface that runs along the back of the sofa and fluidly connects the room.

The wooden structure features clearly defined volumes and visible joints, revealing construction as part of the design. While providing practical support, Meandro also acts as an architectural element, defining, organizing, and enhancing the space around the sofa.

Within the Simbiose collection, the Meandro Sofa Table represents the balance between form, structure, and use. A piece designed to integrate, support, and connect, turning occasional furniture into an active part of a room's composition, with a calm presence, precise proportions, and timeless character.

name: Model
description: Model is a sofa with a minimalist concept and soft volumes. Its base with aluminum legs lends it a commanding elegance and visual fluidity. Foams of different densities within its structure provide excellent comfort. It offers an endless range of modular arrangements that adapt to every space. Its substantial yet visually fluid presence, aluminum legs, and soft volumes make the Modelo sofa a piece of understated, refined design in any interior. Shown with Palo side tables.

name: Mono
description: Less is more, and the Mono armchair is no exception. It brings sophistication and elegance to pure, simple lines. The clarity of its forms allows it to fit into every kind of setting, while its contemporary style lets it serve either as a supporting piece or as a focal point. With premium foam in its seat and backrest, this armchair offers exceptional comfort.

name: Mono
description: The Mono outdoor armchair was designed to bring this iconic Uultis piece into more settings with greater versatility. With its striking appearance and pure forms, it now features a wooden backrest and high-performance materials for outdoor use, retaining the sophistication and elegance of its contemporary style.

name: More
description: A clean design can also be elegant and exceptionally comfortable. Extendable seats and an adjustable backrest make this sofa a versatile piece that complements and brings practicality to a wide range of settings.

name: Mule
description: The Mule armchair offers a variety of options. With its appealing appearance, it is an excellent choice for furnishing a room, while its upholstered seat and backrest provide comfort. Its modern design puts beauty first and helps create a comfortable, pleasant setting.

name: Musa
description: With a shell-shaped headboard supported by an angular frame covered in foam and fabric, this sophisticated, inviting bed captivates at first sight.

name: New
description: As beautiful as it is versatile and functional, the New ottoman offers two new size options, creating even more ways to use it: as a footrest in front of armchairs and sofas, or as extra seating for guests.

name: Nexo
description:
Wood supports; metal connects; glass reveals.

The conical base concentrates the solidity of the wood and anchors the piece to the floor. Above it, a glass top rests lightly, creating a sense of suspension. Between the two, the visible metal joint becomes part of the design, clearly showing how the table is constructed.

Circle, cone, and cross form the geometry of the piece: essential shapes that span the history of architecture and remain relevant through their clarity and visual strength. To the touch, metal brings precision, wood conveys warmth, and glass reveals lightness and transparency.

Within the Simbiose collection, this table expresses the meeting of natural materials and contemporary technique in a direct, balanced, timeless design.

name: Noronha
description: The Noronha side tables elegantly combine contemporary urban design with the serenity of Fernando de Noronha's natural elements, celebrating the beauty of its distinctive rock formations and the harmony of the archipelago.

name: Nowe
description: The Nowe dining chair stands out for its combination of comfort and design. Its organically shaped solid wood frame joins an upholstered seat and backrest to create a distinctive, versatile piece that can serve as a dining chair or an occasional armchair. Ideal for a variety of settings, it provides comfort and elegance while adding refinement to the room.

name: Nowe
description: With peaceful, enjoyable moments in mind, Uultis has brought the Nowe chair into its outdoor collection. Along with a new look, Nowe retains its comfort and quality in a fresh design full of personality, adding elegance and refinement to the setting.

name: Nym
description: Inspired by the water lily, the Nym mirror complements the Nym side tables, bringing the same natural, welcoming touch and a sense of solidity and stability to its composition. Discreet, compact, and thoroughly contemporary, it stands out for its gentle lines and considered use of different materials.

name: Nym
description: Inspired by the water lily, the Nym side tables seek to reproduce the shapes of the plant's leaves and flowers. The wooden top adds a natural, welcoming touch, while the base creates a sense of solidity and stability. Its distinctive design brings functionality and elegance together.

name: Nym
description: Inspired by the water lily, the Nym side tables in the Sense collection seek to reproduce the shapes of the plant's leaves and flowers. The wooden top adds a natural, welcoming touch, while the base creates a sense of solidity and stability. Its distinctive design brings functionality and elegance together.

name: Nym
description: Inspired by the water lily, the Nym panels complement the Nym side tables and mirrors. Their discreet, contemporary design stands out for its gentle lines and skillful combination of materials, creating a natural, welcoming touch.

name: Nym
description: Inspired by the water lily, the Nym mirror complements the Nym side tables, bringing the same natural, welcoming touch and a sense of solidity and stability to its composition. Discreet, compact, and thoroughly contemporary, it stands out for its gentle lines and considered use of different materials.

name: Olga
description: Distinctive, modern lines and a playful design for bold projects: this is Olga. In an almost perfect embrace, wood and upholstery come together to create a clean, contemporary atmosphere.

name: Oris
description:
The Oris desk celebrates the simplicity of its lines and brings an understated elegance. Its tall, tapered legs support a top with a range of customization possibilities, creating a continuous, precise surface for work and creativity.

At the sides, handcrafted weaving softens the rigidity of the design and connects the piece to the work of the hand, adding warmth and identity. Inspired by Italian modernism and Brazilian woodworking, Oris balances rigor and delicacy, bringing technique and sensitivity together.

A desk designed to organize a space with clarity, comfort, and a human touch.

name: Orla
description: Designed to evoke calm and a connection with nature, this sofa combines aesthetic and functional elements that capture the relaxing spirit of the seafront. Gentle lines and organic curves recall the shapes of sand dunes and ocean waves, creating a naturally fluid, elegant aesthetic.

name: Osa
description: The Osa armchair stands out for its organic design, accentuated by solid wood arms. It has a strong visual personality, making an impression in any setting through its design and comfort.

name: Paipe
description: The Paipe sofa captures the essence of the legendary Pipeline waves in Hawaii, bringing their magic into your home. Its fluid, graceful arms and backrest evoke the majestic curves of the sea, recreating the feeling of being beside crystal-clear water and capturing the energy of this idyllic destination.

name: Pantê
description: The organic shapes of the Pantê mirror series are inspired by the pattern of spots on a jaguar's coat. The wooden joinery frames the mirror, bringing elements of nature into the home.

name: Pantê
description: The organic shapes of the Pantê table series are inspired by the pattern of spots on a jaguar's coat. The wooden joinery frames the mirror, bringing elements of nature into the home.

name: Pantê
description: The Pantê occasional tables are now part of the Sense line. Inspired by the organic patterns of a jaguar's spotted coat, these pieces bring wood design together in a distinctive composition.

name: Pin
description:
Revisited in celebration of the brand's tenth anniversary, the Pin table returns as one of the great icons of the Simbiose collection. Its original design, recognized for its slender, distinctive bases, takes on new proportions and a new relationship with the tabletop.

The columns supporting the piece seem to rise from the ground like firm yet delicate stems, opening into circles at the upper plane. Once associated with the grandeur of medieval architecture, Pin now offers a more contemporary interpretation: a balance between strength and lightness.

The verticality of the columns contrasts with the softness of the tabletop, creating a harmonious composition that expresses the concept of symbiosis. The new Pin reconnects with the brand's identity and brings it into the present, reaffirming a design that values time, continuity, and evolution.

name: Pin
description: Pin is a dining table that makes a striking impression at first sight. Its base structure recalls the corridors of Gothic castles. Its columns open out at the tabletop, allowing for other predefined configurations.

name: Plot
description: All the natural appeal of clean, gentle forms. Inspired by vintage style, its structure is made of solid wood with natural cotton-based weaving. The finish is beautiful.

name: Plot
description: All the natural appeal of clean, gentle forms. Inspired by vintage style, its structure is made of solid wood with natural cotton-based weaving. It features a clear tempered-glass top over the natural weave, adding sophistication and durability. The finish is beautiful.

name: Plot
description: All the natural appeal of clean, gentle forms. Inspired by vintage style, its structure is made of solid wood with natural cotton-based weaving. It features a clear tempered-glass top over the natural weave, adding sophistication and durability. The finish is beautiful.

name: Raco
description: The Raco coffee table connects two worlds: the dynamic and the serene. Its elegant, multifunctional design is characterized by straight lines and geometric forms, recalling the structure and order of urban buildings. At the same time, it uses natural materials, such as wood and woven cane, that evoke the calm and solidity of the natural landscape.

name: Radi
description:
In the Radi table, solid wood becomes both structure and expression. Its bases, formed by groups of supports that cross and support one another, recall the engineering of traditional roofs and the aerial roots of tropical trees. Here, the structure is not hidden: it is the highlight of the design itself.

Revisited in a commemorative edition, Radi reinforces the meeting of nature and construction, two pillars of Brazilian design. By bringing together traditional references and organic forms, the piece joins the Simbiose collection as a clear symbol of connection and balance.

Radi celebrates ten years of history by returning to what sustains the brand: solidity, identity, and time.

name: Radi
description: Radi is a dining table with a solid-wood structure that references roof supports as well as the aerial roots of trees. It is perfect for anyone who wants a piece of furniture with personality in their home.

name: Raízes
description: Inspired by the majestic banyan tree, the Raízes table evokes the energy of nature and the vitality of a design connected to the essence of life. The sinuous, elegant forms of the base reflect the harmony of roots intertwining in a remarkable connection with the earth, while the tabletop celebrates the togetherness that a shared table makes possible.

name: Raízes
description: Inspired by the majestic banyan tree, the Raízes table evokes the energy of nature and the vitality of a design connected to the essence of life. The sinuous, elegant forms of the base reflect the harmony of roots intertwining in a remarkable connection with the earth, while the tabletop celebrates the togetherness that a shared table makes possible.

name: Raúm
description: The Raúm dining table is inspired by the Amazon River. This piece of furniture uses different materials in its base and features a hammered-glass top that recalls the river's waters. The concept behind the table is to bring a piece of nature into the home, honoring the beauty and grandeur of the Amazon River. The use of varied materials in the base, such as wood and metal, creates a distinctive and interesting texture while reinforcing the idea of the table as a tribute to nature. The hammered-glass top adds a touch of elegance and sophistication while evoking the image of the river's moving waters. Overall, this dining table is a design piece that combines beauty and functionality in a distinctive and captivating way.

name: Régia
description: Régia is a set of minimalist occasional tables. Their tray-like structure, bronze-mirrored tops, and polished stainless-steel legs make them sophisticated pieces of furniture through the simplicity of their form.

name: Rio
description: Inspired by Rio de Janeiro, the Marvelous City, the Rio sofa combines urban and natural elements that reflect the city's vibrant, diverse essence. With a design that recalls Rio de Janeiro's architecture and iconic beaches, its materials and contours were conceived to convey warmth and comfort, evoking the relaxed character of coastal areas and natural landscapes.

name: Ritmo
description:
Throughout the twentieth century, repetition became a form of expression in design and art. Instead of using ornament, many artists began to organize space through rhythm, sequence, and proportion.

In the Simbiose collection, Ritmo emerges from this idea. The piece uses wooden slats repeated at regular intervals, creating a continuous design that guides the eye from one side to the other. Metal adds visual lightness, while wood provides presence, solidity, and a sense of permanence. The side wheels reinforce the ideas of movement and structure.

Ritmo is a piece with clear, precise lines that organizes space naturally, with elegance and personality.

name: Riva
description: The Riva chair combines urban dynamism with the serenity of nature. Inspired by the Italian word "riva," which refers to the banks of a river or the shores of a lake, this piece of furniture offers comfort and elegance in a contemporary design with natural elements.

name: Rudá
description: Inspired by the god of love in Tupi-Guarani mythology, the Rudá mirror embodies the essence of love and passion in their purest, most vibrant form. Its circular shape evokes the sun, a source of light and warmth that nourishes life on our earth. Just as the sun illuminates every corner of the world, the Rudá mirror reflects the light of inner beauty, revealing the true essence of those who look into it.

name: Ruy
description: Substantial volumes and organic, light, contemporary lines are defining characteristics of the work of the iconic Ruy Ohtake, and they are reflected in every line of the Ruy sofa.

name: Ruy
description: Substantial volumes and organic, light, contemporary lines are defining characteristics of the work of the iconic Ruy Ohtake, and they are reflected in every line of the Ruy sofa.

name: Ruy
description: Conceived through the union of innovation and sophistication, the new version of the Ruy upholstered sofa takes comfort and design to a new level. With touches of wood at its ends, it brings together the natural beauty of wood and the coziness of upholstery. This fusion of contrasting elements is more than aesthetic: it represents the meeting of nature and comfort, sophistication and authenticity.

name: Savana
description: The sofa is inspired by the characteristics of the Brazilian savannas, known for their biodiversity, lush landscapes, and peaceful atmosphere. This sofa combines natural elements, comfort, and elegance to create a setting that evokes the beauty and serenity of Brazil's savannas.

name: Scalene
description: One upholstered design; many ways to relax. Escaleno is available as an armchair, a module with two arms, an armless module, and a chaise longue with arms. All have a welded aluminum frame, which provides greater strength and prevents creaking and structural failures. Comfort for every day.

name: Senilia
description: The gentle forms of the Senilia bed evoke the calm of low tide, in the rhythm of waves that carry a shell to the beach and into the comfort and warmth of the sand.

name: Serena
description:
The Serena chair balances functionality and delicacy in a design inspired by the Brazilian modernist tradition. A molded-wood shell joins a metal frame, creating a piece with visual lightness and precise construction.

Designed for indoor and outdoor areas, it maintains a discreet, elegant presence in any setting. The metal base ensures solidity, while the range of finishes allows Serena to adapt to different kinds of spaces, from residential to corporate interiors.

Serena combines comfort, durability, and a contemporary design, making it a versatile, distinctive chair capable of enhancing projects with personality and sophistication.

name: Serena
description: The Serena stool expresses the balance between functionality and delicacy through the precise dialogue between its metal frame and upholstery, evoking the Brazilian modernist tradition in which visual lightness and technical rigor coexist. Conceived to move naturally between settings, it maintains a discreet, elegant presence, reinforced by its metal base and the versatility of finishes that allow it to adapt to different spatial narratives. Its essence lies in the paradox between robustness and delicacy, uniting performance and poetry to establish itself as an expression of contemporary identity in any project.

name: Serena
description:
The Serena Bistro Set was created to bring practicality and sophistication to everyday life. Table and chair share the same design language, combining aluminum, wood, and fabrics prepared for outdoor use, allowing the set to adapt naturally to different settings, from a residential balcony to an urban café.

The handcrafted-glass top celebrates manual craftsmanship, while the slatted detail reinforces the identity of the line and engages with Brazilian modernist design.

Serena creates spaces for gathering and spending time together, balancing comfort, durability, and visual lightness in a set designed to be used and appreciated.

name: Serenus
description: Inspired by the tranquility of a serene dawn, the Serenus mirror evolves from a functional object into a portal to moments of introspection and clarity. Its name evokes the essence of calm, purity, and light. Straight lines and minimalist design capture the beauty of simplicity, while its clear reflection conveys not only an image but also a sense of inner peace.

name: Shell
description: Comfort and good taste to accompany the finest meals. The Shell dining chair is made of solid wood and has a foam-padded seat and an MDF backrest with a curved surface finished in natural wood veneer, or a version with both the backrest and seat covered in foam.

name: Shell
description: Comfort and good taste to accompany the finest meals. The Shell dining chair is made of solid wood and has a foam-padded seat and an MDF backrest with a curved surface finished in natural wood veneer, or a version with both the backrest and seat covered in foam.

name: Sintonia
description:
The Sintonia table emerges from the meeting of balance and clarity of form. Its design highlights the composition of wood and glass, creating a light, precise, clearly defined surface in which each material retains its identity.

The wooden frame surrounds the glass top and gives the design a rigorous structure, while the transparency allows light to pass through the piece and brings visual lightness to the setting. The result is a table with a quiet presence, distinguished more by proportion and care than by an abundance of elements.

In the Simbiose collection, Sintonia expresses the harmony between the natural and the contemporary: a piece conceived to organize space with serenity, balance, and sophistication.

name: Slot
description: An armchair that inspires comfort and almost embraces its occupant: this is Slot. Composed of rounded forms and a carefully designed backrest intended to provide a sense of coziness, the armchair also features wooden legs and a wooden backrest.

name: Smile
description: The Smile upholstered sofa has a contemporary design defined by gentle lines and organic forms that harmonize with any type of setting. If you are choosing between elegant and relaxed, choose both.

name: Soho
description: Perfect for those who appreciate beauty, and even more so for those who appreciate comfort. Its appearance is guided by vintage style, with fine, elegant lines and the natural character of solid wood shaped into distinctive forms. The leather and metal embellishment is inspired by fashion trends and details.

name: Sotto
description: With a vintage design, it features gently shaped edges worked in solid wood. Choose your favorite backrest: upholstered in fabric or woven from natural cotton threads in a hexagonal pattern. Versatility that lets you relax in your own style.

name: Sotto
description: The Sotto stool, built from solid-wood components in a vintage style, has lines that flow with spontaneity and lightness. It features a solid-wood frame with a natural finish and a foam seat upholstered in fabric. The backrest is made of woven cotton.

name: Sotto
description: With a vintage design, it features gently shaped edges worked in solid wood. Choose your favorite backrest: upholstered in fabric or woven from natural cotton threads in a hexagonal pattern. Versatility that lets you relax in your own style.

name: Sotto
description: The Sotto stool, built from solid-wood components in a vintage style, has lines that flow with spontaneity and lightness. It features a solid-wood frame with a natural finish and a foam seat upholstered in fabric. The backrest is made of woven cotton.

name: Star
description:
The Star table stands out through a striking yet quiet presence. Its circular top rests on a fluted conical base that recalls classical columns in an essential, contemporary interpretation, almost a modern translation of an architectural gesture.

Made of wood, Star connects directly with the tradition of Brazilian modernism, in which structure and material play a central role in design. The faceted base creates a play of light and shadow that gives the piece an architectural presence within its setting.

Designed for indoor areas, Star acts as a focal point in the space: a table that organizes the environment around it. In the Simbiose collection, it serves as a gathering place, a surface for shared moments, and a quiet axis that structures the domestic space.

name: Stuzi
description: The solid-wood frame is assembled with screws and secured with PVA glue, providing greater strength and preventing creaking. Both the seat and the backrest are made of plywood and also feature high-density foam. Comfort and durability: everything you need to relax.

name: Suma
description: The inspiration for the Suma dining table comes from the deepest, most pristine groves of the Brazilian Amazon rainforest. The shape of its base symbolizes the grandeur and impact of one of the Amazon's most imposing trees, the majestic Sumaúma. Its intertwining roots are reflected in the base of this dining table. The organic forms are a reminder of the richness of our flora and the strength of nature, coming together to make an impression and fill the dining room with personality and lightness.

name: Suma
description: The inspiration for the Suma dining table comes from the deepest, most pristine groves of the Brazilian Amazon rainforest. The shape of its base symbolizes the grandeur and impact of one of the Amazon's most imposing trees, the majestic Sumaúma. Its intertwining roots are reflected in the base of this dining table. The organic forms are a reminder of the richness of our flora and the strength of nature, coming together to make an impression and fill the dining room with personality and lightness.

name: Tai
description: The Tai armchair is full of personality and has distinctive characteristics. The details of its handcrafted woodwork give the product a style of its own. A wealth of inspiration.

name: Talha
description:
Wood supports. Metal defines. Between them, a quiet dialogue emerges through form and proportion. The conical base concentrates solidity and presence; above it, the metal top extends with precision, supported by a vertical blade that intersects the space. Between these two planes rests a sphere, a point of balance and visual tension.

The forms are elemental: circle, cone, and sphere. These geometries span centuries of architecture and sculpture and continue to symbolize order, permanence, and proportion. In Talha, each element retains its identity while coming together in a single composition in which strength and delicacy coexist.

In the Simbiose collection, Talha represents the meeting of wood, a living material, and metal, a material shaped by contemporary technique. A dialogue between nature and precision, brought together in a piece with an architectural presence, designed to stand the test of time.

name: Tangente
description: Throughout the history of art, the circle and the square have symbolized opposing realms, always in search of balance. The Tangente mirror emerges from this tradition: a circle suspended within a wooden square, supported by two spheres, where elementary geometry reveals its own tension without resorting to ornament, relying only on the gesture of joining distinct forces without either canceling the other out. Tangente translates this historical vocabulary into a functional object in which wood brings warmth, the sphere anchors, and the mirror dissolves boundaries, resulting in a precise, almost cosmic meeting of material and gaze.

name: Trapézio
description: A trapezoid is a flat geometric shape with four sides. This form suggests grounding and solidity, defining characteristics of the TRAPÉZIO bench. Made of wood with upholstery on top, the piece is a key element for settings that need a touch of warmth and comfort.

name: Tre
description: Anyone who thinks the sofa must take center stage to bring something new to the living room should look again. TRE draws the eye to the coffee table: robust and with the strong appeal of wood and woven cane combined, the table is contemporary as well as functional.

name: Treliça
description: Inspired by the aesthetics of architectural latticework, the Treliça occasional tables unite design and functionality through the elegance of geometric forms.

name: Treno
description: The combination of wood and an aluminum frame gives the Treno dining table the lightness and elegance ideal for veranda spaces. Design and quality define the aesthetics of this dining table.

name: Tress
description: Elegance, comfort, and quality brought together by a single thread. The backrest and seat of the Tress chair are made of plywood covered with foam and high-quality fabric. All of this rests on a solid-wood frame.

name: Tupã
description: The Tupã sideboard draws inspiration from Brazilian forests to take shape. The simplicity of its imposing form makes a statement in the room, and its blend of materials demonstrates the richness and diversity of nature and Brazilian design.

name: Tupã
description: The Tupã bar draws inspiration from Brazilian forests to take shape. The simplicity of its imposing form makes a statement in the room, and its blend of materials demonstrates the richness and diversity of Brazilian nature and design.

name: Turati
description: Bringing creativity and functionality together, the Turati mirror explores bold forms and contemporary lines to create a truly distinctive composition. Inspired by avant-garde art and architecture, its striking shapes invite exploration of lines and curves that intertwine in a mesmerizing way, reflecting not only an image but also the artistic expression that surrounds it.

name: Unas
description: The backrest of the Unas armchair creates an outer "shell" and gives shape to this beautiful armchair; its gentle lines make it a piece full of charm. The slender metal legs lift the piece off the floor, adding even more lightness and refinement. Structure: it has a solid-wood frame and metal legs. The seat features elastic webbing, soft foam, high-density foam, ecosoft padding, and medium-density foam. The loose back cushions contain soft foam, medium-density foam, and ecosoft padding.

name: Ura
description: The monumental Ura stool incorporates the arch, one of the most beautiful forms found in nature. Its light lines captivate, turning moments into memorable experiences. Enjoy the possibilities of composing impressive settings.

name: Urbanís
description: A bed that embodies the essence of urban life with the aim of offering superior rest. Its modern, sophisticated design is inspired by the city's vibrant energy. With gentle forms and a contemporary style, Urbanis is the perfect retreat for relaxing and recharging after a busy day, bringing an atmosphere of tranquility that recalls nature.

name: Urca
description: Capturing the essence of Rio de Janeiro's hills, it stands out for a backrest composed of two cylindrical volumes that evoke the harmony of Morro Dois Irmãos.

name: Urubici
description: The sofa recalls the natural beauty and mountain climate of the city of Urubici, located in the Serra Catarinense. It celebrates natural beauty and a peaceful, welcoming way of life, providing a space for comfort and relaxation.

name: Velo
description: Velo has a design in its DNA that reconciles distinct styles in pursuit of a timeless piece. With a solid-wood frame, it is produced using the finest woodworking techniques, while its anatomically shaped, wood-finished plywood contact surface is the key to comfortable, relaxing seating.

name: Vetra
description:
The Vetra sofa grows out of movement and flexibility. Its modules can be brought closer together or moved farther apart, creating different configurations to suit the space and the moment. Low, rounded lines bring a sense of welcome and comfort, with volumes that seem shaped by time.

Inspired by Italian modular design of the 1970s and the clarity of Brazilian modernism, Vetra brings form and function together in a system that adapts to contemporary ways of living. Its idea is simple: to make it possible to rearrange, recompose, and transform a setting naturally.

Vetra turns modules into a complete place: a sofa conceived to accompany life, offering freedom, comfort, and a serene presence in the space.

name: Véu
description:
Véu has a more restrained, precise presence within the collection. Its straight-lined design conveys solidity and discretion, while the vertical handles and contrasting exposed stitching reveal the care of its craftsmanship, with references to suitcases, trunks, and travel objects in which hand finishing is part of a piece's value.

The name suggests the idea of protecting and keeping things with delicacy. Véu is a piece of furniture conceived to organize and preserve, in which function becomes aesthetic value through details and manual work.

In the Simbiose collection, it acts as an elegant counterpoint, reinforcing the balance between what is shown and what is kept private within a space.

name: Vichi
description: Inspired by the stingray, the Vichi dining chair brings the form and movement of this marine animal into its appearance. Its organic lines, a backrest carefully designed to embrace the person seated, and a carved wooden detail on the back, with an aerodynamic design and curves recalling a stingray's fins, evoke its personality and welcoming form.

Its organic lines, a backrest carefully designed to embrace the person seated, and a carved wooden detail on the back, with an aerodynamic design and curves recalling a stingray's fins, evoke its personality and welcoming form.

name: Voga
description: The Voga chair is a tribute to contemporary elegance and timeless sophistication. Inspired by the word "voga," which means being in fashion and in high demand, this piece of furniture combines innovative design with supreme comfort, making it an icon of style for refined spaces.

name: Wave
description:
The Wave chaise longue revisits one of the brand's icons with a new interpretation to celebrate its tenth anniversary. Its clean-lined design and wooden frame engage with modern furniture of the 1950s and 1960s, a period in which form, comfort, and functionality went hand in hand.

The upholstery, arranged in padded segments, follows the gentle incline of the piece and invites extended rest. Every detail was conceived to support the body naturally, transforming sitting into an experience of relaxation and well-being.

The triangular base supports the structure securely while lending visual lightness and an elegant contrast between solidity and fluidity.

In the Simbiose collection, Wave presents itself as a piece that brings memory and the contemporary together. It reconnects with the vintage inspiration of its origins while emerging in an updated form, reaffirming a design that values time, quality, and permanence, conceived to span generations and furnish settings with personality and sophistication.

name: Wave
description: Wave is a vintage-inspired bench with a wooden frame and fabric upholstery. An essential piece for any contemporary interior design project.

name: Wave
description: Wave is a vintage-inspired chaise longue with a wooden frame and fabric upholstery. An essential piece for any contemporary interior design project.

name: Win
description: Along with its vintage style, the armchair features gentle forms worked in solid wood and metal embellishments that add even more charm to the arms. Small details make all the difference.

name: Wing
description: The Wing dining table has a vintage design and a distinctive appearance. Its legs have a unique shape, with beveled forms worked in solid wood. Your own way to enjoy your home.

name: Zaha
description: Curves and organic forms are important characteristics incorporated into Uultis pieces. The Zaha bed is an example: inspired by the work of architect Zaha Hadid, the piece carries symbolism. Zaha is a form of futuristic architecture that celebrates curves and sharp angles. The result is an unconventional, striking bed.

name: Zenith
description: Zenith is the highest point, the moment when everything converges in perfect balance. In the Zenith occasional table, this idea takes shape: the metal structure rises gently, like a gesture toward the light, supporting a stone top that rests serenely. The base anchors the whole, establishing a dialogue between lightness and firmness, between what rises and what remains.
